Tests shred FEC resolution, signing, Merkle roots, rolloff, and chained shred formats.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the shredder and FEC resolver code used in the shred pipeline. It builds shred batches from fixture data, signs shreds with a test Ed25519 key, and feeds them into `fd_fec_resolver_add_shred` to verify shred acceptance, rejection, completion, and spill behavior. The tests cover normal batch flow, interleaved batches, resolver rolloff, shred version checks, Merkle root handling, forced completion, and chained Merkle shreds.

The file also checks that generated shreds match expected FEC sets and that resolver output matches the shredder output. It uses imported binary fixtures such as `demo-shreds.bin`, `chained-5XDmMEZpXM2GBXNjhgRCti4qLGeFQvx4RnzWeRgfupYk.ar`, and `resigned-AmKFVSAQ7DyhiW94pWfDexYDCSn8GB6SG2zbQqLhuufU.ar` to validate parsing and format handling. The [`main`](<#main>) function initializes the runtime, registers metrics, runs all test cases, prints `pass`, and stops the process.
